deviations.what: onValueHelpRequest loads ValueHelpDialog.fragment.xml, pre-filters it by the Input's value and opens it; the port builds the same SelectDialog with popup_display, applies the same pre-filter through binding_call and writes the picked title back into the two-way bound value.
onSuggestionItemSelected reads the Input's selectedKey; the key travels straight from the selected suggestion item (${$parameters>/selectedItem}.getKey()) and is shown in the bound Text.
The KeyValue suggestions, the value help and the selected-key readout are unverified in a running system.
